examples.claim: By default the ingress __call__ receives a Starlette request
examples.source: key-concepts.html: 'By default, the __call__ method of the class is called and passed in a Starlette request object.'

examples.claim: bind returns a DeploymentNode wrapping the deployment, linkable into a deployment graph
examples.source: tutorials/serve-ml-models.html: '...returns a DeploymentNode object, a wrapping of the TFMnistModel deployment object...'

examples.claim: By default one HTTP proxy runs on the head node (Uvicorn); proxy_location runs one per node
examples.source: architecture.html: 'By default there is one HTTP proxy actor on the head node.' Note: production-guide/config.html says 'EveryNode (default)', which the post also states at L575 -> docs-internal conflict copied unreconciled

examples.claim: Request objects of 100KiB+ go through the object store with zero-copy reads; smaller ones by network call
examples.source: architecture.html: 'Larger request objects (100KiB+) are written to the object store and the replica can read them via zero-copy read.'

examples.claim: PrefixCacheAffinityRouter: match rate >=10% -> highest match; <10% -> lowest cache utilisation; imbalanced -> p2c
examples.source: llm/architecture/routing-policies.html: 'High match rate (>=10%) ... Low match rate (<10%) ... Fallback: Use Power of Two Choices when load is imbalanced.'

examples.claim: Anyscale: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B on 64 L4 (8x 8xL4) with RayTurbo; TTFT -60%, throughput +40%+
examples.source: anyscale.com blog: '60% reduction in time-to-first-token (TTFT) and more than 40% improvement in end-to-end throughput'; 'eight 8xL4 machines (64 GPUs total) ... using RayTurbo'; 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B'

examples.claim: Body not forwarded to router by default; RAY_SERVE_INGRESS_REQUEST_ROUTER_FORWARD_BODY=1; BUFSIZE cap; TCP_NODELAY on by default (RAY_SERVE_HAPROXY_TCP_NODELAY=1)
examples.source: llm/user-guides/direct-streaming.html: 'By default HAProxy doesn't forward the request body to the router'; 'Ray Serve sets TCP_NODELAY by default (RAY_SERVE_HAPROXY_TCP_NODELAY=1)'

examples.claim: RayServeHandle and RayServeSyncHandle fully removed in Ray 2.10
examples.source: model_composition.html: 'The deprecated RayServeHandle and RayServeSyncHandle APIs have been fully removed as of Ray 2.10.'

examples.claim: TF MNIST example reshapes the JSON array to (1, 28, 28)
